title: Gurgaon: Car follows woman biker, hits her bike and flees; incident caught on cam
content: A woman biker claims a car repeatedly followed her on Sunday. The car allegedly hit her motorcycle and then fled the scene. Footage shared online shows the alleged collision and the car driving away. A friend pursued the car and confronted the driver at a traffic signal. The biker has appealed to Gurgaon Police for action and accountability.

title: Houthi drone attack: Saudi oil stocks could run dry soon if key pipeline remains shut
content: Saudi Arabia's oil exports face imminent disruption from drone attacks on a key pipeline.  The kingdom has only a few days of oil stocks remaining for export.  This shutdown threatens to remove a significant portion of global oil supply from markets.  The east-west pipeline is crucial for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz for shipments.  Saudi oil production has already reached a thirty-year low, exacerbating the situation.

title: Tech VC on Nike’s worst-ever stock fall: ‘Mastery & excellence became too traditional’
content: Nike's stock has recently seen a substantial dip, igniting discussions about the brand's core identity. Venture capitalist Chamath Palihapitiya suggests that Nike may have deviated from its principles of mastery and excellence. He believes that the brand should refocus on motivating consumers by highlighting the commitment of elite athletes. The decline in shares has cost Nike billions, as it navigates changing consumer habits and growing competition.

title: Rs 6.42L business travel paid via wife’s card, man gets tax notice; what ITAT said
content: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Mumbai has provided partial relief to a businessman after the income tax department disallowed Rs 6.42 lakh of his travel expenses because the payments had been made using his wife's credit card.

title: Coach's fasting, nod to Dhoni, 'funniest' team: Inside Ganges Grandmasters' GCL title
content: Ganges Grandmasters stunned the favourites, APL Pipers, to win the GCL 2026 title on Sunday, powered by an unconventional team culture built on humour, trust and camaraderie. First-time coach Adiban Baskaran became the unlikely catalyst, blending superstition, calmness inspired by MS Dhoni, and personal bonds with players. Ian Nepomniachtchi and Stavroula Tsolakidou delivered decisive wins, completing a remarkable underdog triumph.

title: 9 dead in 3 days after consuming spurious liquor in Nagaland
content: Nine people have died in Nagaland's Tuensang district hospital over three days. These deaths are reportedly linked to consuming spurious liquor, prompting a police alert. The victims complained of breathlessness after drinking suspected adulterated rum. Authorities are investigating the source of the contaminated alcohol and those responsible. People are advised to abstain from drinking liquor as a precautionary measure.

title: Bought as a Christmas gift in 1986, this Super Mario Bros sold for $660,000
content: In 1986, a sealed copy of Super Mario Bros. was bought as a Christmas gift and forgotten in a desk drawer. It remained untouched for 35 years before being discovered and auctioned in 2021. The rare, professionally graded game sold for $660,000 at Heritage Auctions, setting a new world record for the video game.

title: England brought back ospreys after 149 years; 300 chicks have now fledged
content: After a dramatic 150-year absence, conservationists have triumphantly reintroduced ospreys to England. Young chicks, sourced from Scotland, began their journey to Rutland Water in 1996. Remarkably, these avian travelers instinctively returned to their new home, initiating a breeding cycle that has led to over 300 fledglings now populating the area. This successful initiative marks a pivotal moment in conservation efforts.

title: Jeff Bezos to Mamdani: ‘Villain strategy’ won’t work; Ken Griffin isn’t hurting New York
content: In a recent statement, Jeff Bezos took aim at New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's approach to a proposed tax initiative. He emphasized that demonizing individuals isn't a viable strategy for tackling systemic issues. While he endorses the concept of the pied-à-terre tax, he disapproves of Mamdani's focus on targeting businessman Ken Griffin. Bezos highlighted that the real challenge lies in government inefficiency rather than imposing higher taxes alone.

title: Watch: Zverev didn’t realise he had won the US Open — until the crowd told him
content: After a six-year delay, Alexander Zverev triumphantly claimed his first US Open title, defeating Ben Shelton in a match full of memorable moments. This victory provided a sweet redemption from his 2020 final loss. Reflecting on his achievement, Zverev acknowledged the unwavering support from his family and team, underscoring the significance of this Grand Slam win during a superb season for the German athlete.

title: Tata Harrier EV breaks down repeatedly; dealer to refund price, pay Rs 65K
content: A consumer commission ordered Tata Select Motors to take back a Tata Harrier EV. The vehicle repeatedly developed smart-key and central-locking problems despite repairs. The commission directed a refund after deducting ten percent depreciation from the vehicle's price. It also awarded fifty thousand rupees compensation and fifteen thousand rupees costs to the buyer. The order was passed on September 7, 2026, for issues arising in 2025.

title: Alaska teen survives 62 hours at sea: How the 15-year-old fought hypothermia
content: In a harrowing tale of survival, a fifteen-year-old boy was left drifting for sixty-two grueling hours on the Bering Sea after a fishing tragedy took his brother and cousin. As he clutched an overturned skiff, hope seemed dim until rescuers, spotting his distinctive yellow jacket, rescued him, leaving the community torn between relief for his survival and grief for their losses.

title: 'Everyone's been bugging me': Trump to remove 10% duty on Irish whiskey

This action responds to ongoing pleas from Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin and the golfing community. The Distilled Spirits Council of the United States views this as a welcomed change that will positively impact businesses and consumers in the upcoming holiday period.

title: Kargil War veteran attacked with iron rod in Gurgaon over parking row

The confrontation occurred over a parking dispute at Magnum Global Park, where the attendant reportedly wielded an iron rod. Following the incident, police have received a complaint aimed at launching an attempted murder investigation.

title: Shot down over Iran, hunted for 50 hrs: How US fighter survived behind enemy lines

The officer, injured, hid in Iran's desert while Iranian forces searched for him.  US forces used bombers and drones to strike Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces nearby.  This mission demonstrated the US commitment to recovering its personnel.

title: Old planes and no money: Pakistan's air force is about to go into a nosedive

title: Russia offers Rs 16 lakh per foreign soldier for Ukraine war: Report
content: the increase in Irkutsk comes as Russian regions step up recruitment incentives . the payment is reportedly the highest reward offered by any Russian region for recruiting foreign nationals into the military . a total of 1.5 million rubles (around Rs 16 lakh) are offered for each foreign citizen or stateless person recruited to fight in the war against Ukraine .

title: 'A ceremony of light': First-ever Ganga Aarti held on River Thames in London - video
content: the first-ever Ganga Aarti in London was organised by Chinmaya Mission UK . it was part of global celebrations marking the 75th anniversary of the Totally Thames festival . the ceremony recreated the spirit of the world-famous Ganga aarti held along the river Ganges in india .

title: SIR notices to 38 members of Iranian-origin family in Jharkhand
content: the family resides in wards 1 and 3 under Garhwa Nagar Parishad . officials have begun examining how their names were included in the draft voter list and whether they meet eligibility requirements . the administration is also scrutinising the benefits extended to the family under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana .

title: Jersey City moves to save 20-year community garden with $1.2 million purchase
content: a small lot on Glenwood Avenue in Jersey City served as more than an empty parcel between buildings . neighbors turned it into a community garden, growing tomatoes, peppers and other produce while creating a shared place to meet, work and learn . the property owner obtained permits for development, raising the possibility the garden would disappear beneath a new building .

title: Pregnant woman among four killed in attacks on Kuki villages in Manipur
content: suspected NSCN (IM) and ZUF (K) cadres allegedly carried out two separate attacks in manipur’s Tamenglong and Noney districts on Sunday . the attacks took place on a day observed by the Kuki community as ‘Black Day’ to commemorate those killed and displaced during the violence of the 1990s .
